installAgentPrompt: Setha i-HAX (https://haxtheweb.org) kule khompyutha. Faka i-HAX CLI nge-`npm install @haxtheweb/create --global`, bese ufaka amakhono ayo e-ejenti nge-`hax skills install --all`. Yenza isayithi nge-`hax site my-hax-site --y --no-i`, uyiqale nge-`cd my-hax-site && hax serve`, bese ungitshela ikheli eliliphrintayo.
